description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointments of the Commission of Inquiry made by the Hon. President of the Democratic, Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a Commission of Inquiry to investigate alleged irregularities in state-owned enterprises (SriLankan Airlines, SriLankan Catering, Mihin Lanka). The document is a legal instrument issued under the Commissions of Inquiry Act, outlining the commission's mandate, powers, and legal authority. It focuses on the legal framework for an investigation into potential malpractices, which falls under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification for legal notices and statutory instruments. While it names individuals being appointed as commissioners, the primary purpose is not a personnel change but the creation of a legal body with specific investigative powers.
